question: The first railway line was from ______ to ______ in India in 1853.
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Mumbai to Thane**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• India’s first rail run on Mumbai – Thane route in 1853.
 
• It was the first passenger train to run in India.
 
• It had three locomotives – Sahib, Sultan, and Sindh, and 14 carriages.
 
• A distance of 34 km was covered by the train.
 
• Based on the success of this rail, the launch of Eastern railway in 1854 and South railway in 1856.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian Railways began its operations from 16 April 1853.
 
• The Railway Board is the apex body of the Indian Railways.
 
• It reports to the Parliament of India through the Ministry of Railways headed by the Railway Minister of India.
 
• Its headquarters New Delhi, India.
 
• The current Railway Minister of India is Ashwini Vaishnaw.
 
• Chairman & Chief Executive Officer​ of Railway Board: **Shri Anil Kumar Lahoti**
